source: WC3 TFT current melee data (patch 1.36 / Reforged 2.0), rawcodes from Blizzard UnitData.slk/UpgradeData.slk naming, cross-checked against common.ai constants; requirement details from knowledge, not extracted from game files (no war3.mpq/CASC on box)
notes: requires = buildings that must exist (completed, owned) besides the producer
tier equivalents: a higher hall satisfies a lower hall requirement (equivalents)
level_requires[i] = extra buildings needed for level i+1 of an upgrade
how: build|train|upgrade (building morph)|research:<Rxxx> (unit transforms after research)|ability
families: weapon/armor upgrade families per race that should share max level
heroes also need: 1 hero free per altar tier (2nd hero at tier2, 3rd at tier3) - checker treats hero count as info only
verified overlay: requirements of listed ids taken from Liquipedia (current patch); shop_items = per-shop items with extra required building/tier

Naga: taken from stock campaign data (campaignunitfunc.txt Builds/Trains/Researches, campaignupgradestrings.txt). Naga is not a playable melee race: single hall tier, no requirements set in stock data, Royal Guard/Summoner not trainable. Use it as a reference for a 5th race, not as melee balance.
